title: Coefficients of the reverse of a polynomial
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $T$ an indeterminate and $f\in R[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $d=\deg f$ ($d=0$ for $f=0$), and let $\operatorname{rev}(f)$ be its reverse [def-weil-reverse-polynomial]. Then for every integer $j\ge0$ [def-weil-polynomial-coefficient]

$$
[T^j]\operatorname{rev}(f)=\begin{cases}[T^{d-j}]f,&0\le j\le d,\\0,&j>d.\end{cases}
$$
